name: review-driven-development
description: Review-driven development: make a large change readable by curating its commit history into a bottom-up narrative (split-pr), pair-run the implementation layer by layer (pacer), validate a multi-PR stack structurally (validate-stack), manage the PR chain (stacked-prs), and hand wider audiences a guided-reading deck (pr-deck). Never publishes placeholders a later PR removes.
